summary: Steep residential kerb, about 16% grade, with houses 10-15 m away.

drivers.seclusion: Houses 10-19 m away on the kerb's own side and across the road; no screening.
drivers.access_and_room: Cars park along the kerb, but the whole stretch falls 6 m over 38 m.
drivers.traffic: Quiet suburban street, but it runs to a junction at the bottom.
drivers.convention: Cars park along both kerbs, so a van would not stand out, but slope rules it out.

flags: Dwelling 10 m from kerb at 28 m
sun_shade: Mostly open; trees shade the west footpath side in the afternoon.
